title: Reduce both ways between permanent and weighted all-matchings relative approximation with positive weights
statement: For p=per(A)>0, Q=2^(2B_A)(n+1)^n bounds Z(A)/p. At t=ceil(8Q/epsilon), p<=t^-n Z(tA)<=(1+epsilon/8)p; a Z interval of ratio1+epsilon/4 gives L=L_Z/[t^n(1+epsilon/8)],U=U_Z/t^n. Conversely B_q=[[A,ones],[ones,q*ones]], q=n+ceil(16n^2/tau), has per(B_q)=sum_k m_k(A)c_k, c_k=(q!)^2 q^(q-n+k)/(q-n+k)!, with c0<=c_k<=c0 beta_q, beta_q=[q/(q-n+1)]^n<=1+tau/8. Permanent intervals at tau/4 yield L_Z=L_B/(c0 beta_q),U_Z=U_B/c0.
